_how_to_use: Filled in by the team, by hand. 1) Write each member's name (as it should be printed) and, if wanted, the course and the university. 2) A member who has run the check that section 9 of the report gives him or her sets check_done to true in his or her OWN entry and writes the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and one sentence on what the check showed. 3) Rebuild the documents: python code/build_report.py ; python code/build_slides.py ; python code/build_qa.py . An empty name prints the role of the plan; a check without date and result counts as not done.
course: Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Large Language Models
